changelog: Fixes: the restart offer no longer appears while an update is still being applied (restarting then could leave the system half updated); the start-up screen no longer shows an error or a broken image on a normal start, and can no longer last forever (a kernel that cannot start, an npm repair that hangs or a very slow start now end in the recovery screen); the setup highlights no longer show two empty sections; the Updater says when the chosen channel is older than your version and lets you switch back with a confirmation. The project is spelled hyadeOS everywhere; the GitHub address stays hyadeOSS.
